purpose: Explain the four actual multiple-scope configuration matches using already authorized runtime reference metadata, without selecting source origin or computing cost.
target_selection: Reconstruct the same 1776 single/4 multiple configuration classification from pinned metadata; require exactly four two-root Phase2 targets and 1780 distinct mapped source/action references. No guessed source IDs or arbitrary caller paths.
membership: Exact manifest schema, circuit, TRAIN role and circuit-family binding checked before selected metadata projection. Existing mixed-edge metadata validation rows discarded before analysis.
scope_rule: For these two Phase2 circuits only, interpret safe relative log path's first component against the two fixed coverage-root basenames. No suffix search, absolute path, traversal, embedded path following or log opening.
retention: Count all provided target references by mode and observed scope, including outside/zero cases. Missing/duplicate/join-conflicting references fail closed. Repeated references across different sources remain distinct source-reference units.
interpretation: One-scope concentration or multiple-scope references are observations, not original source provenance or invocation certification. Always PARTIAL_SCOPE_OWNERSHIP_NOT_CERTIFIED; no majority vote or version assignment.
gate: Independent implementation and synthetic tests before one focused actual local diagnostic. No remote calls or source-measurement reads. Preserve failure evidence; not a retry of the completed E39 join.
